- [USER] User is interested in social work programs at the University of Sydney.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The University of Sydney offers several social work programs, including:
  - Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) - a four-year undergraduate degree.
  - Master of Social Work (MSW) - a two-year graduate degree.
  - Graduate Diploma in Social Work - a two-year program for those with a non-social work undergraduate degree.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The BSW program covers social justice, human rights, advocacy, social research, policy analysis, and intervention strategies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The MSW program includes specialized areas such as mental health, child welfare, and community development, along with a supervised field placement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Graduate Diploma in Social Work includes foundational courses and a supervised field placement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The social work programs prepare students for careers in social work, community development, policy analysis, and advocacy.
- [USER] User expressed interest in the field placement component of the programs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The field placement is a crucial part of the program, usually taking place in the final year and ranging from 400 to 1,000 hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Students cannot choose their placement location; the university helps find a suitable placement based on interests and career goals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Students work under the supervision of qualified social workers or social care professionals during the field placement.
- [USER] User inquired about specific areas of focus or specializations in the social work programs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Specializations available include:
  - Mental Health
  - Child and Family Services
  - Policy and Advocacy
  - Community Work
  - Indigenous Social Work
- [USER] User expressed particular interest in the Indigenous Social Work specialization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Indigenous Social Work specialization covers Indigenous cultures, histories, social issues, and culturally appropriate social work practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Core topics include Indigenous-specific social work frameworks, social and emotional wellbeing, and community development.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The specialization includes a supervised field placement in an Indigenous service organization or community.
- [USER] User asked about the application process for the Indigenous Social Work specialization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The application process includes:
